statements.statement: When you reassign a variable, the old value is kept alongside the new one.
statements.explanation: The old value is replaced and gone. The variable only holds one value at a time.

statements.statement: Reassigning a variable changes the value inside, but the label stays the same.
statements.explanation: Exactly right. The name of the variable stays the same; only the contents change.

statements.statement: A variable can be updated more than once during a program.
statements.explanation: Variables can be reassigned as many times as needed while the program runs.
